text: In Vallecas, Madrid, in 1991, fifteen-year-old Verónica looks after her three younger siblings while her widowed mother works long hours. During a solar eclipse she and two friends [hold a séance with a Ouija board|trigger|calling on unseen powers] in the school basement, hoping to reach her father, and the glass shatters, dripping her blood onto the board. A blind nun called Sister Death tells her [a dark spirit has attached itself to her|threat|being taken over], body-shaped burns appear on the children's mattresses, and a friend recalls Verónica whispering that [she would die in three days|rules|death on a deadline].
